new_value: Landed in 4d97a71. auth_methods is now a closed AuthMethod enum in hire-core, derived from the evidence in Claim::derive beside the tier, and HireClaims::new takes it typed so the two lists can no longer be transposed. The vocabulary names MECHANISMS (key_possession, hardware_key_possession, idp_session, idp_token, user_presence) rather than sources, so a consumer policy does not have to enumerate attestors -- SPEC-HIRE's illustrative tailscale_oidc/fido2_up was the source-shaped form and is replaced, with the reasoning recorded in a new spec section. Acceptance criteria met: the two arrays can differ (asserted end to end in hire-grpc/tests/svid_list.rs) and one candidate with several kinds of evidence emits several methods, sorted and deduplicated. PlatformAssertion maps to None, which closes persona-ouo5.7: a bare Unix box issues auth_methods [] rather than ['unix'], so a 'must be non-empty' policy stops being unconditionally satisfied. gpg's field 15 is no longer collapsed into a boolean, so a card-held key reports hardware_key_possession -- the fact persona-qbnm.1 deferred here -- and KeyCustody carries a tripwire, asserted by a test, that it must never raise the tier. Custody is read by the verifying constructor rather than supplied by the attestor. Live: unix [], tailscale [idp_session], gpg and did:key [key_possession].
